description: Defines scheduling parameters and functions for uplink and downlink grant parameter selection in UE scheduling within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: dl_sched_context
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for downlink scheduling, including search space, resource index, MCS, layers, RBs, and pending bytes.

classes.name: ul_sched_context
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for uplink scheduling, including search space, resource index, VRB limits, RB limits, MCS, RBs, pending bytes, and PUSCH config.

methods.name: get_newtx_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended downlink parameters for a new transmission grant.

methods.name: get_retx_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended downlink parameters for a retransmission grant.

methods.name: compute_newtx_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Selects downlink VRBs for a new transmission based on decision context and used VRBs.

methods.name: compute_retx_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Selects downlink VRBs for a retransmission.

methods.name: get_newtx_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended uplink parameters for a new transmission grant.

methods.name: get_retx_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Retrieves recommended uplink parameters for a retransmission grant.

methods.name: compute_newtx_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Selects uplink VRBs for a new transmission.

methods.name: compute_retx_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Selects uplink VRBs for a retransmission.
